answer: Each payout sits in a crystal vault that opens only when a gale, a random beacon gust, summons the claimant to a live proof within minutes. The claim is sealed by a cipher key split into five shards, each held by a stranger who releases theirs only after verifying one distinct past job. Shards expire at the next gale and cannot be reused. One operator cannot answer n summons or pass n stranger checks at once, and shards cut from the same cipher fracture the vault and slash both claims. A fleet pays n fees and n shard sets for one payout, so cloning cost grows faster than cloning reward.
